output.reason: The brief explains the facts well: night receiving was cut in week 31, probes are keyed hours after the trailers empty, and write-offs rose on nights for every supplier while day shift stayed flat. That points clearly to dock dwell time, not Haverlow, and the brief sets out what to do (restore night put-away speed and cap dock-to-chamber time) and what not to do (no chargeback or volume shift); I'd trust it more with the new evidence attached, but the logic fits what I've seen.
